responsibility: Declares the default FIO-backed method set used to adapt ordinary gm2 file handles to the generic device interface defined by RTgenif. Its procedures cover single-character reads and unread, errno retrieval, block reads and writes, line output, and end-of-file/end-of-line/error predicates, providing the reusable per-device callbacks that concrete file-channel modules such as StreamFile, SeqFile, RndFile, StdChans, and TermFile install into their generic device wrappers.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the declaration half of the RTfio pair, publishing the reusable FIO-based callback signatures for generic devices; the companion RTfio.mod contains the actual adapter code that forwards those callbacks to RTio/FIO operations on the underlying file handle.
